messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: Alert triggered: slo_burn_rate_high for service=/api/v1/generate region=prod-us-east burn=6.2x window=10m link: https://ops.redwood.example/alerts/2003456789
Alexa: ack — I'm oncall now, paging started. grabbing logs and tracing.
Mike: ack from infra. I can jump on redis/kv and the routing table. seeing >30% 500s from the gateway in the last 5m.
Sarah: looking at model pool metrics — one GPU host showing heavy GC and OOM kills, fallback to cpu instances causing latency spikes.
Alexa: can we circuit-break the canary traffic to the v2 weights? last deploy at 10:12 UTC.
Mike: rolling back weight canary -> issuing patch to traffic-router:
```bash
curl -X POST https://router.internal/config -d '{"route": "/api/v1/generate","variant":"v1","weight":1.0}'
```
Mike: applied. verifying.
SRE-Bot: Incident note: rollback performed by Mike. Added annotation to incident.
Alexa: good. I'm also temp-muting the slo noise alert channel for 15m to avoid repeated pages while we stabilize. Will keep paging policy for customer-impacting alerts.
Jordan: FYI CS reported 18 tickets in the last 12m complaining about timeouts — we should flag potential P1 if customer visible.
Sarah: correlating traces -> majority of errors show redis timeouts and large KV miss storms from embedding-cache. There's a surge in embedding re-computations.
Mike: turning on embedding-prefetch cache (feature flag) to reduce recompute: `feature.embedding_prefetch=true` at edge.
Alexa: done. initial qps drop 20% and tail latency improving.
Alexa: quick ask about SLO alerts — current burn alert fires at 5x over 10m and pages on >4x, but we've had a lot of oscillation from transient infra blips. Can we discuss adjusting multi-window parameters postmortem?
Jordan: definitely — while this is active we should avoid changing thresholds that hide real customer impact. For now keep paging for >4x 10m and >2x 30m, but after we stabilize we should propose multi-window tuning.
SRE-Bot: Added temporary suppression for non-customer-facing routes. Original alert config saved at /ops/alert-configs/slo_burn_rate_high.yaml
Alexa: monitoring dashboards updated — created a quick panel for per-route burn and per-customer error rate. Link: https://dashboards.redwood.example/d/incident/2003456789
Sarah: adding one-off dashboard for embedding cache hit-rate and redis latency.
Mike: infra note: one GPU node had an old kernel driver causing swap pressure. I cordoned it and started replacement. That should stop the OOM kills that cascaded.
Alexa: seeing error rate drop from 14% -> 4% over 6m. Good.
Jordan: CS escalation: asked to mark affected customers list and send templated note. Alexa / Mike can you confirm estimated impact window and affected routes?
Alexa: estimate: ~10:10–10:30 UTC for partial errors on /api/v1/generate and async embedding endpoints. Majority had retries succeed; ~3 customers had sustained failures needing manual replay.
Mike: we'll compile request ids and hand to support.
Alexa: operational action items (adding to thread):
- preserve logs and traces for 10:05–10:35 UTC
- draft customer note for impacted accounts (Jordan/Sales)
- post-incident: evaluate multi-window burn thresholds and add a secondary 4h window to suppress noisy 10m spikes that don't lead to customer errors
Jordan: +1. Also propose adding budget policy: only page if lifetime burn>2x AND 10m burn>4x OR customer_error_rate>0.5%. That should reduce pages for internal flakiness.
Sarah: we should also add automatic detection to mute alerts for routes with embedding-cache rebuilds (too noisy). But ensure we keep a gating alert that pages if 5xx rate crosses absolute threshold like 1%.
SRE-Bot: Noted. Created postmortem checklist item: `evaluate_slo_burn_multiwindow_policy`. Assigned to Alexa and Mike.
Alexa: I'll own the postmortem write-up and proposed alert changes. Plan: run a 2-week trial with adjusted multi-window config in staging and evaluate false-positive rate.
Mike: I'll implement a canary for the new alert rules and add a dashboard for alert fidelity.
Jordan: handing off — I'm next oncall at 11:00 UTC. Alexa, please escalate if anything regresses.
Alexa: handing off: current state stable, rollback complete, embedding-prefetch enabled, GPU node replaced. Will update handoff in #eng-oncall.
Jordan: ack. Thanks team. :thumbsup: We'll reconvene for a post-incident review tomorrow 14:00 UTC to finalize SLO burn tuning and dashboard additions.
SRE-Bot: Incident closed for paging after stabilization. Postmortem ticket: https://tracker.redwood.example/IN-4921
Alexa: closing thread notes — adding tags: incident, slo, alert-tuning, embedding-cache, followup:postmortem
Mike: :eyes: logging followup tasks to the infra board.
Jordan: :spiral_calendar: See you at the review.
